name: cctv
short: Two live Pixel Agents office pages on one listener.
description: Owns the Discord guild projection, registered-agent editor projection, WebSocket listener, Dashboard pages, display policy, and activity clear timing for both CCTV views.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores per-guild display settings. Through corridor's office-state store, it also persists Discord user IDs and registered agent IDs that have avatar appearance or seat assignments.
install_msg: Requires corridor and pixelagents (auto-loaded). Configure the reverse proxy for /cctv/discord/ws and /cctv/editor/ws; Dashboard pages are /third-party/cctv/discord and /third-party/cctv/editor.
author: Tin Nguyen
